# Calm Investments

> Calm Investments is an independent entrepreneurial investment firm based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands (founded 2021). It focuses on acquisitions of and participations in small and midsized Dutch companies with a leading role in their niche market.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2021, Rotterdam
- Office: The Blaak House, Blaak 34, 3011 TA Rotterdam, the Netherlands
- Contact: j.vanderhelm@calminvestments.com, +316-1233 8883
- Founders: Olav van Caldenborgh (previously CEO of Caldic; acquired and integrated 20+ companies) and Jonathan van der Helm (previously strategy consultant at Roland Berger; MSc Offshore Engineering, TU Delft)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/80161694/

## Focus

- Geography: the Netherlands
- Sectors: niche manufacturing, value-added distribution, food, machine building, healthcare & pharma
- Investment criteria: EBITDA EUR 0.5m-5m, niche market leaders with mission-critical offerings, high value-to-cost proposition, consistent earnings history, identifiable growth potential, experienced management team

## Approach

Long-term entrepreneurial partnership with management, based on transparency, integrity and mutual trust. No exit-driven strategy. Support includes data analytics, growth strategy development, evaluating and executing M&A, financial support and operational collaboration.

## Participations

- Mineraux (https://www.mineraux.nl/): white pigment manufacturer, the world's only safe and equally white replacement for titanium dioxide (E171)
- Koekjesbakkerij Veldt (https://www.koekjesbakkerij.nl/): producer of traditional artisan biscuits and cookies in Veenendaal
- Krakend Vers / OnOats (https://onoats.nl/): producer of artisan oat crackers, oat cookies and granola in Bunschoten-Spakenburg
